description:
In the past 200 years of palaeontology. There’s been some pretty incorrect educated guesses about dinos. There’s also been completely wrong  wild guesses, and shots in the dark that fully missed the mark. For decades, movies, books, and pop culture have shown Pterodactylus as a giant, screeching dinosaur that carried people away in its claws. But almost everything we think we know about it… is wrong.
